capabilities: Create a note from selected PDF text with a quote and your own comment
Capture a PDF region as a PNG image note
Link a highlight note back to its place in the PDF
Drag highlight notes onto a canvas as cards
List all highlights of the open PDF in a sidebar
disambiguation: Not a PDF markup editor; it paints highlights over the PDF for display only and never modifies the PDF file itself.
extras: Part of the ICOR for Life suite; the README labels the plugin Beta and asks users to open issues when something looks off. Works on desktop and mobile, though on phones only the toolbar is available.
motivation: The author wants highlights to become real notes with the reader's own thought added, so passages from many PDFs can be gathered on Topic pages months later without reopening any PDF.
problem: Highlights inside a PDF are dead ends: they can only be seen by reopening the PDF, so they cannot be searched, linked, or collected across documents.

relations.evidence: Part of the ICOR for Life suite.

summary: PDF highlight extractor that turns selected text or captured regions into vault notes with deep links, canvas cards, and a per-PDF highlight sidebar.
